items.title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans
items.summary: Anthropic宣布Claude Code的Auto模式将于8月14日起成为Pro、Max和Team计划的默认设置。第三方评估测试显示，Auto模式成功阻止了720次针对Claude Fable 5、Opus 5和Sonnet 5的提示注入攻击，而人类测试者的拒绝率仅为13.6%（Auto模式阻止率达89%）。

items.title: I Built Scenario Packs for Agent Regression Testing. The Integration, Not the Judge, Broke Me.
items.summary: EvalForge是一个用于工具型AI Agent回归测试的开源评估框架，v0.1版本包含20个场景，覆盖10个类别（如单工具检索、多工具合成、结构化提取等），另有8个安全场景（提示注入、数据外泄、SSRF等）。其核心设计是场景包中的expected和metrics字段通过build_invocation_payload函数在发送给Agent前被剥离，Agent仅接收输入、可用工具列表和预算，无法获取答案以作弊。这一机制确保评估结果真实反映Agent行为而非对评分标准的猜测。

items.title: Stop Prompting Like It's 2024
items.summary: 2026年编程agent能力大幅提升，但prompt策略需从"寻找魔法句式"转向让任务难以误解、难以作弊且易于验证。

items.title: Show HN: Faaah – Filesystem as an AI Handler
items.summary: FAAAH是一个仅308行代码的零依赖工具，通过文件系统协议将OpenAI兼容请求转为.txt文件交由已有AI Agent（如Claude Code）处理。客户端向本地端口发送OpenAI格式请求后，FAAAH将其写入队列文件夹，AI Agent读取并写入回复文件，FAAAH再封装为OpenAI JSON格式返回。

directions.name: PromptShield CLI
directions.description: 为 Claude Code / AI Agent 应用提供提示注入漏洞扫描的 CLI 安全审计工具
directions.description_en: A CLI security audit tool that scans for prompt injection vulnerabilities in Claude Code and AI Agent applications.
directions.target_user: 使用 Claude Code 或其他 Agent 框架构建应用的独立开发者和一人公司
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and solo founders building applications with Claude Code or other AI Agent frameworks
core_features: 自动检测 Agent 提示词中的注入点与边界绕过风险
集成到 CI/CD 流水线，每次提交自动运行安全扫描
生成漏洞报告并提供修复建议
core_features_en: Automatically detects injection points and boundary-bypass risks in Agent prompts
Integrates into CI/CD pipelines for automated security scanning on every commit
Generates vulnerability reports with actionable fix recommendations
directions.why_now: Anthropic 刚刚宣布 Claude Code 的 Auto 模式将成为默认设置，并在第三方评估中成功阻止了 720 次针对 Claude Fable 5、Opus 5 和 Sonnet 5 的提示注入攻击，而人类测试者的拒绝率仅为 13.6%（Auto 模式阻止率达 89%）。这证明随着 AI Agent 从手动模式转向全自动模式，提示注入已成为企业级应用的关键安全隐患，开发者急需工具来预防此类攻击。社区热议点集中在 Auto 模式的默认启用和实际安全成效上，时机正好。
directions.why_now_en: Anthropic just announced that Claude Code's Auto mode will become default, successfully blocking 720 prompt injection attacks against Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5 in third-party evaluations, while human testers only rejected 13.6% (Auto mode achieved 89% block rate). As AI Agents shift from manual to fully autonomous mode, prompt injection has become a critical security concern for production apps. The community discussion is centered on Auto mode's default enablement and its real-world security effectiveness, making this the perfect timing.
directions.monetization: 开源 CLI 免费版 + 付费 Pro 版（$29/月，含 CI/CD 集成、自定义规则库、团队协作功能）
directions.monetization_en: Open-source CLI (free tier) + Pro subscription ($29/month for CI/CD integration, custom rule library, and team collaboration features)
directions.source_article: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans

directions.name: AgentBench Studio
directions.description: 面向 AI Agent 开发者的场景化回归测试托管平台，预置行业场景包并支持自定义测试编排
directions.description_en: A hosted regression testing platform for AI Agent developers with pre-built industry scenario packs and custom test orchestration.
directions.target_user: 正在构建工具型 AI Agent 的独立开发者和小型团队
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and small teams building tool-using AI Agents
core_features: 预置 20+ 场景包（单工具检索、多工具合成、结构化提取、安全对抗等），开箱即用
可视化测试编排：拖拽组合场景、设置期望输出与指标阈值
Agent 版本迭代时自动运行全量回归测试并生成对比报告
core_features_en: Pre-built 20+ scenario packs (single-tool retrieval, multi-tool composition, structured extraction, security challenges) ready to use out of the box
Visual test orchestration: drag-and-drop scenario composition with expected outputs and metric thresholds
Automatically runs full regression tests on Agent version updates with comparative reports
related_trends: 开源 Agent 测试框架
directions.why_now: DEV Community 上的讨论《I Built Scenario Packs for Agent Regression Testing. The Integration, Not the Judge, Broke Me.》揭示了 Agent 回归测试的核心痛点：现有框架（如 EvalForge v0.1）虽然开源可用，但集成体验差，场景包管理与测试编排缺乏产品化封装。该框架已包含 20 个场景覆盖 10 个类别和 8 个安全场景，但开发者仍面临整合难题。随着 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具 becoming more autonomous, 开发者对 Agent 可靠性和回归测试的需求正快速上升，而市场上缺少一个产品化的托管测试平台。
directions.why_now_en: The DEV Community discussion reveals the core pain point in Agent regression testing: while frameworks like EvalForge v0.1 are open-source and available, the integration experience is poor and scenario pack management lacks productized packaging. The framework already includes 20 scenarios covering 10 categories and 8 security scenarios, but developers still struggle with integration. As tools like Claude Code become more autonomous, demand for Agent reliability and regression testing is rising rapidly, yet there's a gap in the market for a productized hosted testing platform.
directions.monetization: 免费试用 50 次测试运行 + 付费订阅（$19/月 1000 次运行，$79/月 无限运行 + 自定义场景包），按测试用量计费
directions.monetization_en: Free trial (50 test runs) + paid subscription ($19/month for 1000 runs, $79/month for unlimited runs + custom scenario packs), usage-based pricing
directions.source_article: I Built Scenario Packs for Agent Regression Testing. The Integration, Not the Judge, Broke Me.
